content.comment_body: Hi, I'm experiencing issues with displaying the value from a PT100 sensor. The screen flickers between 22-23 at room temperature. Is there a way to decrease the sampling rate or something similar? I have already tried various resolutions and amplifiers but haven't found a solution.
Hello, I recommend double-checking your wiring. If the issue persists, consider reviewing similar forum threads for potential solutions. Regards,

Thanks for your prompt reply—the advice helped with the sampling rate and display. However, I'm still receiving temperature readings fluctuating between 21.0 and 24.5 degrees Celsius in a stable room environment. Is this expected behavior? For wiring, I have PT100: red to M1+, red to IC1, white to M1- (reds are bridged), and when measuring between red and white, I observed a few hundred ohms.
Hello, The PT100 sensor connection seems fine. Is the power supply for the module properly grounded at the 0 VDC side? This is essential. Regards,

The issue was indeed related to grounding at 0VDC. Now the display shows a stable 23.3 degrees Celsius, confirming that was the original problem. It's also useful to know how to modify sampling rate settings. Thank you!

analysis.insight_summary: Users discussed unstable temperature measurements from a PT100 sensor connected to an input module and controller. The fluctuating readings and screen flicker were resolved after correcting an improper power supply grounding. There was also interest in adjusting the sampling rate to improve display stability and measurement accuracy.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the system to deliver stable and precise temperature readings from the PT100 sensor and seek the ability to modify sampling settings to prevent display flickering.
